title: observability: token-level KV metrics, tracing spans, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Samir Gupta
description: Motivation: Improve visibility into KV cache behavior at token granularity and reduce alert noise caused by transient increases in KV miss latency. This PR adds token-level KV metrics (hit/miss counts, per-token latency histograms), tracing spans around KV cache lookup and serialization, a Grafana dashboard update with cost/latency breakdown by token and model variant, and tuned alert rules to reduce false positives while preserving signal for regressions. Changes include Prometheus metric renames to follow our telemetry conventions, new metrics registry initialization to avoid double-registration in tests, and a lightweight sampling mode for high-traffic routes to keep cardinality bounded. Testing: unit tests for metric emission and integration tests that exercise trace propagation through the request pipeline. Rollout plan: deploy metrics and tracing code first (non-breaking), enable dashboard and tuned alerts in staging for 48h, then promote alerts to prod if no regression is observed. Related: ENG-3245 (token-level observability epic), SRE-221 (alert tuning).
